conflicts.claim_as_written: On serving cost: we're scoping and staffing a distillation training recipe from scratch to compress the autoregressive colorizer into a feed-forward student for cheap serving — Hyun owns the recipe design inside his 60%, Maren supports on training infra. There's nothing on the shelf internally we can reuse for this, so I've budgeted it as a fresh build with a first student checkpoint targeted mid-June.
